[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The 1855 directory indexes Michael Glasgow with the residence field Manchester, Lancashire, England. The listing identifies a shoemaker at 211 Deansgate. It does not establish a connection to Michael Glasgow of Tipperary and Ontario.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/6252689 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: Michael Glasgow, 1855, record 3145/6252689].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
This directory entry describes the named subject. Birth date and wider identity remain unresolved.

[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The 1879 directory indexes Jolm Glasgow with the residence field Herefordshire, England. The index spells the forename Jolm. The address and trade are 27 Widemarsh Street and travelling draper. Littlebury’s 1876–77 Hereford directory gives the same address and trade and spells the forename John.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/25853440 Ancestry, UK, City and County Directories, 1766–1946: Jolm Glasgow, 1879, record 3145/25853440].</ref>

[https://texts.wishful-thinking.org.uk/Littlebury1876/HerefordAlphabetic.html Littlebury’s Directory and Gazetteer of Herefordshire, 1876–77, Hereford alphabetical listings] gives John Glasgow at the same address.

== Biography ==
The 1898 directory indexes Ernest Glasgow with the residence field Middlesex, England. The occupation field gives tailor and Chestnut ho.
